_doc: Hand-verified Torment.exe v3.2.2.0 field offsets (hex). Each entry: pt offset + how it was proven.

m_cMessageHandler.why: every AddMessage call site: mov rcx,[g_pBaldurChitin]; add rcx,0x1760 (BG 0x1768)

lEngines.why: fieldprobe: list head reads [rcx+0x58] vs BG [rcx+0x60], 2 aligned sites

m_cInfinity.why: fieldprobe: 30 lea rcx,[rbp+0x5d8] vs BG 0x5c8 (CInfinity itself is 0x40 smaller before +0x2e8)

m_visibility.why: fieldprobe: pointer/lea at field start [reg+0xb88] vs BG 0xbb0

m_lVertSort.why: fieldprobe: list head [rcx+0xc18] vs BG [rcx+0xc38]; m_lVertSortBack 0x38 later as in BG

m_tDexterityMod.why: CRuleTables ctor (PT 0x296583): C2DArray::Load after the DEXMOD CString (BG 0xee0)

m_tWeaponSpecialization.why: CRuleTables ctor (PT 0x29695d): C2DArray::Load after the WSPECIAL CString (BG 0x1500)

m_equipment.why: 339 reads mov r64,[sprite+0xfb8] (items pointer) and ~120 movzx [sprite+0xfc0] (m_selectedWeapon); 0xfb8+0x20 = m_pDialogData 0xfd8

cResRef.why: PT CAIScript::Construct (0x176d80) runs the CResRef ctor on this; next member (CObList) moves from +8 to +0x10
